escalations.title: proxy-addr IP Spoofing via IPv4-Mapped IPv6
escalations.escalation_reason: Network-level access control bypass — affects all backends trusting X-Forwarded-For

escalations.title: tinypool Prototype Pollution → RCE
escalations.escalation_reason: RCE via prototype pollution in worker threads
escalations.fix: npm update tinypool to v1.1.0+ or v0.4.0+

escalations.title: vitest Arbitrary File Read/Execute (Dev Server)
escalations.escalation_reason: Source code disclosure and RCE when Vitest UI server active
escalations.fix: npm update vitest to latest patched version; disable UI server in CI
escalations.note: Dev-only but critical for security posture

escalations.title: protobufjs Arbitrary Code Execution via Malformed .proto
escalations.escalation_reason: Arbitrary code execution via input validation bypass on .proto parsing
escalations.fix: npm update protobufjs to latest; validate all .proto sources

escalations.title: handlebars JavaScript Injection via AST Type Confusion (SSTI)
escalations.escalation_reason: Server-side template injection — injection trigger in config
escalations.fix: npm update handlebars to v4.7.9+; never render user input as templates

p1_findings.title: pending_dependencies status absent from WorkItemStatus enum; dispatch gating at wrong transition
p1_findings.failure_scenario: POST /api/work-items/:id/approve on item with unresolved blockers silently succeeds (status=approved), then POST /api/work-items/:id/dispatch returns 400 — caller expected 200 with pending_dependencies state
p1_findings.recommendation: Add PendingDependencies to WorkItemStatus enum; add approve→pendingDependencies transition; check blockers in approve handler; cascade dependents in dependency.ts

p2_findings.title: dependencyCheckDuration histogram missing from metrics.ts (FR-dependency-metrics)
p2_findings.fix: Add Histogram for dependency_check_duration_seconds; instrument computeHasUnresolvedBlockers/isReady

p2_findings.title: BlockedBadge missing amber state for pending_dependencies (FR-dependency-blocked-badge)
p2_findings.fix: Add status prop to BlockedBadgeProps; render amber badge when status === PendingDependencies (blocked by QO-001)

p2_findings.title: Specifications/tiered-merge-pipeline.md — 10 FRs (FR-TMP-001-010) fully orphaned, no plan, no source
p2_findings.fix: Create Plans/tiered-merge-pipeline/requirements.md OR mark spec Status: Deferred

p2_findings.title: Traceability enforcer checks only most-recent plan — multi-plan gaps invisible to CLAUDE.md gate
p2_findings.fix: Update CLAUDE.md gate to run both plans explicitly, OR add --all flag to enforcer

p2_findings.title: body-parser DoS via Invalid Limit (unbounded body parsing)
p2_findings.fix: Update body-parser; validate limit param in Express middleware

p2_findings.title: brace-expansion Zero-Step Sequence DoS (infinite loop via malformed brace patterns)
browserslist Unbounded Memory Growth (cache never evicts → OOM)
p2_findings.fix: Update browserslist to latest; monitor memory in CI builds

p2_findings.title: form-data CRLF Injection via Unescaped Multipart Field Names
p2_findings.fix: Update form-data; validate all user-supplied field names

p2_findings.title: js-yaml Quadratic-Complexity DoS via Merge Key Aliases
p2_findings.fix: Update js-yaml; set strict mode; limit YAML file size

p2_findings.title: nanoid Non-Secure Generator Loop Indefinitely on Negative Size
p2_findings.fix: Update nanoid; ensure all calls use positive size

p2_findings.title: postcss XSS via Unescaped </style> in CSS Output
p2_findings.fix: Update postcss; sanitize CSS output before rendering

p2_findings.title: source-map-js Event-Loop DoS via Indexed Section Offsets
p2_findings.fix: Update source-map-js; disable source maps in production

p2_findings.title: Vite Path Traversal in Optimized Deps (.map file handling)
p2_findings.note: DIRECT dependency — most urgent P2 fix

p3_findings.title: Duplicate frontend test files — root + pages/ for WorkItemDetailPage and WorkItemListPage
p3_findings.fix: Delete root tests/WorkItemDetailPage.test.tsx and tests/WorkItemListPage.test.tsx; keep pages/ variants

p3_findings.title: OpenTelemetry absent from Source/Backend (CLAUDE.md non-negotiable rule)
p3_findings.fix: Add @opentelemetry/sdk-node and instrumentation packages; initialize in app.ts; add custom spans
